faq.q1: Is this giveaway open in my country?
faq.a1: Available globally except where prohibited by local law. The following jurisdictions are excluded from paid-entry promotions at launch: Quebec, Brazil, mainland China, and OFAC / EU / UN sanctioned regions. The free in-app entry path (download Libo + complete a workout to earn Libo) is open in every other jurisdiction. Minimum entry age varies by giveaway type — see Terms (Section 3).
faq.a2: No. Every pack is a single one-time payment. No subscription, no auto-renewal, no recurring charges. You buy it once, you get the Libo and access window, that's it.
faq.q3: Do I receive my Libo and access instantly?
faq.a3: Yes. The moment your payment confirms, your Libo are credited to your Libo account and your full-app access window starts. Convert Libo to giveaway tickets in-app whenever you want.
faq.q4: Do I get the iPhone or the cash?
faq.a4: Your choice. We ship the iPhone 17 Pro to you, or wire the €1,200 cash equivalent — whichever you prefer. Decision is yours after the draw.
faq.a5: Libo pays out the full prize with no tax withheld. Your personal tax obligations depend on your country of residence — please check local rules.
faq.q6: What happens when my access window ends?
faq.a6: Your account simply reverts to whatever tier you were on before — Free, Pro, or Elite. Nothing is auto-charged. Any unconverted Libo stay in your balance permanently. Want more access? Buy another pack, no commitment.
faq.q7: Where can I watch the live draw?
faq.a7: Libo's Instagram (@liboworld) and TikTok (@libo.world). The full draw is archived for replay. You don't need to watch live — winners are contacted directly via the email tied to their account within 24 hours.
faq.q8: I'm already a Pro / Elite subscriber — what happens?
faq.a8: You keep your existing subscription, untouched. The pack credits its Libo to your balance and extends your access window — no double-charge, no plan downgrade. Buy as many packs as you want; Libo and access days stack.
faq.q9: Can I buy multiple packs? Do Libo and access stack?
faq.a9: Yes — every pack adds to whatever's already on your account. Buy Entry today and Gold next week and you've got 3,100 Libo plus 37 days of full-app access (7 + 30). We use the email you give us to find your existing account or create a new one.
faq.q10: Do I need a Libo account before buying?
faq.a10: No. We auto-create one with the email you provide at checkout and send you a magic link to sign in. Existing Libo users (anyone who's signed up before) get the Libo and access credited to their existing account — same email = same account.

faq.a1: No. Every single person who completes 30 active days gets paid. It's a guaranteed payout for consistency, not a draw.
faq.q2: What counts as a completed day?
faq.a2: Hitting your tier's daily rep count for that day, logged in the Libo app. Reps can be split across multiple sessions. Push-ups auto-count via camera; squats and pull-ups use a tap counter.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss a day?
faq.a3: Free tier: one miss and you're out for that cycle. Pro: freeze tokens cover missed days — each token pushes your end date by +1.
faq.a4: Within 14 days of completing your 30th active day, after identity and anti-fraud checks pass. Payout is to the linked account on file — Stripe / SEPA / Wise depending on region. Payout providers require winners to be 18+; if you're 16–17, you can use a parent-linked verified payment account, otherwise the reward is converted to equivalent in-app credit (extra tickets or a Premium month) within 14 days.
faq.q5: Can I enter multiple tiers at once?
faq.a5: No — one active enrollment at a time. You can enroll in the next cycle's tier once your current one ends.
faq.a6: The reward is a real cost to Libo. Capping spots makes the payout budgetable and creates a real cohort feel — everyone runs the clock together.
faq.q7: Do I need a Libo subscription?
faq.a7: Free Starter tier — no. The Pro pools (€10 and €50 rewards) need Pro (€9.99/mo). Subscribe in the app when you join your tier.
faq.a8: Start with Starter (100 reps/day) — that's about 5 minutes of work, splittable across the day. The rep count is achievable; the discipline is the challenge.

faq.headline: Frequently asked.
faq.q1: How is Libo different from other fitness apps?
faq.a1: Libo combines a massive exercise library, structured programs, progress tracking, and real cash challenges in one app — with a premium dark UI that stays out of your way. No ads, no clutter. Most apps promise motivation; Libo literally pays cash for consistency.
faq.q2: How do the money challenges work?
faq.a2: Join a 30-day challenge (e.g., 100 reps daily), record yourself completing the reps each day, share to your stories, and cash out real money when you finish. Limited spots per challenge.
faq.a3: Libo offers a free tier with access to workouts, exercises, basic tracking, common product giveaways, and an entry-level cash challenge. Premium unlocks the full library, advanced analytics, larger cash rewards (up to €50), and Premium giveaways.
faq.a4: None — or everything. Libo has 295 home exercises (most need no equipment), 313 gym exercises, and 33 mobility moves. Filter by what you have available.
faq.q5: Can I build my own workouts?
faq.a5: Yes. The Custom Builder lets you pick from the full exercise library, set your own sets, reps, and rest times, then save and reuse your workouts anytime.
faq.a6: Yes — Libo launches on iOS and Android at the same time. Join the waitlist and we'll tell you the moment it's live on both.
faq.a7: Yes. Libo includes multi-week programs designed for specific goals — muscle building, fat loss, mobility, and more. Follow the plan, log your progress, and see real results.

hero.sub: Libo isn't one founder's fitness app. It's a training club built around a simple bet: people don't fail because they lack workouts — they fail because nothing happens when they quit.

why.imgAlt: Noah F., founder of Libo, carrying two friends on his arms

pillars.title: Forged in Leistungssport
pillars.body: Noah comes from high-performance sport: years of Regionalliga football in Germany, selected for the DFB Stützpunkt and the Westfalenauswahl with Bonner SC. Discipline held because something real was always on the line — a squad, a selection, a season. Libo rebuilds those stakes for everyone else.

pillars.title: One step back, two steps ahead
pillars.body: Off the pitch, Noah built two successful companies — the fashion label Mieuxnoir and the fashion production company Manufactnow. But life set him back a step more than once: wrong calls, hard restarts. Every time, he came back two steps ahead. That's the pattern Libo rewards — not perfection, the comeback.

pillars.title: Skin in the game beats motivation
pillars.body: Loss aversion is stronger than willpower: people fight harder to not lose €15 than to win a badge. Libo's 30-day cash challenges put real money on your consistency — do the reps, post the proof, cash out. Quit, and it cost you something.

pillars.title: A club, not an audience
pillars.body: No coaches or influencers selling courses — whoever joins the club later, members access everything through Premium. Cash challenges run in small cycles of 50, streaks are public, and members hold each other to it. The product is the people showing up — the app just keeps score.

boilerplate.title: About Libo
boilerplate.body: Libo is a training club that pays members real cash for consistency. Alongside a library of 641 exercises, 140 workouts, and AI-built training plans, Libo runs 30-day money challenges: members hit a daily rep target, record the proof, share it publicly, and cash out €5–€50 at the end of the cycle. Libo launches on iOS and Android with a free-forever tier and a Premium subscription at €79.99/year.
boilerplate.founderBio: Noah comes from German high-performance sport — years of Regionalliga football, with selections for the DFB Stützpunkt and the Westfalenauswahl with Bonner SC. He is also the designer behind the fashion label Mieuxnoir and founder of Manufactnow, a fashion production and consulting company. His bet with Libo: real stakes beat motivation, so the club puts real money on member consistency. He writes about the psychology behind it on the Libo blog ("30 Days, One Habit, Real Money").
